sentences.japanese: 金は打ち延ばされ薄い板になった。
sentences.english: The gold was beaten into thin plates.

sentences.japanese: 金の延べ棒１本を盗まれた。
sentences.english: We had a bar of gold stolen.

sentences.japanese: 勤務時間が延びて、社員の不満の声を上げた。
sentences.english: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.

sentences.japanese: 教育の年限を今より延ばすべきだ。
sentences.english: Education should be carried further than it is now.

sentences.japanese: 我々は天気が変わるまでピクニックを延ばした。
sentences.english: We postponed our picnic pending a change in the weather.
